# perf-stat

Collect hardware performance counters using perf stat.

Runs `perf stat` on cores 0 to `N_CORES-1` for `PERF_TIME` seconds, collecting
events such as LLC misses, L1 cache misses, branch misses, TLB misses, and
instructions per cycle (IPC). Computes and outputs miss ratios.

Use the tag `perf_all` to enable a larger set of hardware events than the default events.

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut perf-stat N_CORES=4 PERF_TIME=5
```

See also [`perf-class`](perf-class.md).

Source: [`modules/perf-stat.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/perf-stat.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N_CORES` | `1` | Number of cores to monitor, from core 0 |
| `PERF_TIME` | `1` | Recording duration in seconds |
| `PERF_EVENTS` | `instructions,cycles,cache-misses,cache-references`<br>`dTLB-loads,instructions,cycles,iTLB-loads,cache-misses,cach…` with `perf_all` | Events to collect on top of the LLC, L1 and branch events |
